689:t_007:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「The 10 o'clock point goes to $n!」

689:t_008:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$ソーラリアン$$ stays fixed right here!」

689:t_008:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「We have five minutes! Any longer than that and this ship won't hold!」

689:t_008:6.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ランド$$!」

689:t_008:9.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I will definitely see it through!」

689:t_008:10.en:
$$ランド$$
「Sorry, but I'm counting on you to clear out the pests!」

689:t_008:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It's an operation the Chief is dead set on! Judge the results for yourselves... as they say!」

689:t_009:2.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're going to perform the $c induction ritual!」

689:t_009:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Is this any time to be goofing around?!」

689:t_009:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's precisely because it's a time like this!」

689:t_009:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Here we go! Your two friends are ready too, right?!」

689:t_009:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's give it our all again today...」

689:t_010:0.en:
$$真徒$$
「I don't know what you intend to do, but it will all end in vain.」

689:t_010:1.en:
$$真徒$$
「After all, you are inferior species who live only by the mercy of the Exalted Ones.」

689:t_010:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「Pray for salvation in your despair!」

689:t_010:3.en:
$$真徒$$
「And chant the words of salvation! Salus!!」

689:t_010:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「Yapping away! Didn't you say you had no intention of talking to us?!」

689:t_010:6.en:
$$スズネ$$
「We've overcome threats like that again and again up to now!」

689:t_010:7.en:
$n
「Right now we just have to believe the Doctor's words and do it! With everything we've got!」

689:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The enemy's chain of command is in disarray!」

689:t_012:0.en:
$$真徒$$
「Don't think damage of this degree can stop the $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$!」

689:t_014:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All right! All units have reached their points!」

689:t_014:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Preparations are complete...! Now we can form the field!」

689:t_015:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What on earth are you going to do, Chief?!」

689:t_015:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「What we're about to do is a kind of gamble.」

689:t_015:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「Properly, we should have done more groundwork for this, given everyone a thorough explanation, and had you understand the essence of it...」

689:t_015:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「But now that it's come to this, we have no choice but to do it...!」

689:t_015:5.en:
$$葵$$
「Everyone... Does that mean it's not just the Reactors, it concerns us too?!」

689:t_015:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「That's right. From now on, you're going to learn the true essence of $$次元力$$.」

689:t_015:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even us, who don't have Spheres?!」

689:t_015:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「A $$スフィア$$ is nothing more than an organ for drawing out $$次元力$$ efficiently.」

689:t_015:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「Originally, anyone should be able to draw out $$次元力$$, in any environment.」

689:t_015:13.en:
$$トライア$$
「What draws out $$次元力$$ is the power of will...! And everything has that will!」

689:t_015:14.en:
$$トライア$$
「Not just living things! Matter, the universe, even atoms!」

689:t_015:16.en:
$$トライア$$
「Hydrogen and oxygen combine and make water...! That is the will of each element!」

689:t_015:17.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's the will of the universe that gives birth to $$バアル$$, and the will of the stars that makes them shine!」

689:t_015:18.en:
$$甲児$$
「You can't just spring something like that on us...!」

689:t_015:19.en:
$$竜馬$$
「This is no time to be listening to fairy tales, Doc!」

689:t_015:20.en:
$$トライア$$
「You of all people should be able to understand!」

689:t_015:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「You've always believed in your machines and fought alongside them, haven't you?!」

689:t_015:22.en:
$$トライア$$
「Machines that took damage too heavy to move, yet moved when you called out to them...」

689:t_015:23.en:
$$トライア$$
「Attacks that put all your feelings into them and punched through the enemy's barrier... Remember that!」

689:t_015:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Even so, are you telling me your partners have no will... no heart?!」

689:t_015:27.en:
$$トライア$$
「And you're on the verge of grasping the truth!」

689:t_015:29.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understanding others, accepting them... and advancing into the future together...」

689:t_015:30.en:
$$トライア$$
「Now, with the $$Ｚクリスタル$$, which gathers people's feelings, and the Spheres, I'm going to release $$次元力$$... the will of matter... for just an instant!」

689:t_015:31.en:
$$トライア$$
「From there on, it's up to you! Draw out the true power of your partner and yourself!」

689:t_015:32.en:
$$真徒$$
「What are you doing, you lot?!」

689:t_015:33.en:
???
「We will not let you advance there.」

689:t_016:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Advancing there is not permitted.」

kept_omissions: 689:t_008:4: Kouji asks the listeners (the Setsuko/route team) to go straight through - subject of '進んでくれ' is 'you' (the point team); written as imperative 'Go straight through there!'
uncertain: 689:t_010:3/4 and t_010:0-2: サルース = 'Salus!!' (Latin for salvation) left romanized; brief 08 has the same chant, other agent may choose differently.
689:t_010:1: あの方達 = 'those beings' (the Sidereal's masters) - referent not stated in the slice.
689:t_016:2: 真徒 saying アドヴェント様 - 様 dropped per honorific rule ('Oh... Advent!'); reads flat for a worshipful line.
689:t_009:2: 入隊の儀式 = '$c induction ritual' (AG to Beck).
689:t_008:1: ソーラリアンは、ここに固定だ = 'The Solarian stays fixed right here!' (ship held in place as the field anchor).
689:t_008:11: ごろうじろ rendered 'Judge the results for yourselves... as they say!'
689:t_015:5: bare リアクター = plain 'Reactors' (as earlier slices).
689:t_015:30/22: Traia 'Doc' / 'the Doctor' (博士) for Traia; Suzune/$n refer to her as the Doctor.
689:t_009:7-10: 今日も張り切って...商売！ split across AG/T-Bone/Dove/Beck as 'Let's give it our all again today... / Business! x3'.
